test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Art is a reflection of society.

P: It communicates emotions beyond words.

Q: From cave paintings to modern murals, art evolves.

R: Artists express views on culture, politics, and identity.

S: It also raises awareness on social issues.

6. Hence, art holds immense power in society.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** (QPRS).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Q** ("From cave paintings to modern murals, art evolves") provides a historical/chronological opening that sets the stage.
 
• **P** ("It communicates emotions beyond words") explains art’s primary function — emotional communication.
 
• **R** ("Artists express views on culture, politics, and identity") gives specific ways artists use art to comment on society.
 
• **S** ("It also raises awareness on social issues") follows naturally as a consequence of R and leads into the concluding statement (6).
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is *Option 1 (QPRS)*.

 

**Coherent passage after rearrangement (Q → P → R → S):**

From cave paintings to modern murals, art evolves. It communicates emotions beyond words. Artists express views on culture, politics, and identity. It also raises awareness on social issues. Hence, art holds immense power in society.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Why other options are weaker__**

 
• **PRQS** (option 3) starts with the general function of art before establishing its historical context — less natural than Q first.
 
• **QRPS** (option 2) places R before P so specifics (artists’ views) come before the general communicative function — slightly less logical.
 
• **RSPQ** (option 4) disrupts chronology and logical progression (puts specific expression and social awareness before the explanatory/emotional and historical context).
